mechanism: Both drugs undergo hepatic metabolism and may compete for metabolic pathways; sulfamethoxazole can inhibit CYP450 enzymes while albendazole is metabolized by these same pathways, potentially increasing albendazole levels.
action: Monitor for increased albendazole side effects (dizziness, headache, gastrointestinal upset); consider therapeutic drug monitoring if available and adjust albendazole dosing if toxicity occurs.
